title: doctor: three cost-comparison bugs plus some enhancement ideas
body:
Found several problems in the per-version cost comparison:

1. Versions are sorted lexicographically, not by semver, so 0.10.0 sorts before 0.9.0.
2. The regression detector is one-sided — it flags cost increases but never improvements.
3. Percentage deltas off a near-zero base dominate the ranking.

Some ideas while we're here: it would be nice to have a --json export, and maybe a colorized TTY table, and a weekly email digest.
